name: claude-skills
description: A collection of Claude skills, plugins, and subagents. Includes mbb-deck-plugin (MBB-style management consulting presentations) and claude-memory-harness (project memory + hooks harness).

plugins.name: mbb-deck-plugin
plugins.description: Build presentations in the structural style of top-tier management consulting firms: Pyramid Principle storylines, action titles, MECE structure, and minimal executive-grade visuals. Includes /storyline and /critique-deck commands plus storyline-reviewer and qa-reviewer subagents.

plugins.name: claude-memory-harness
plugins.description: Turn stateless Claude Code sessions into ones with a persistent lab notebook: CLAUDE.md standing instructions, dated + attributed .claude/rules project memory, and tested SessionStart/PreCompact/Stop hooks. Ships the 'memory-harness' skill — say 'install my harness' in any repo to copy, adapt, and verify the template there.
